description: Team Pulse Production System — Automated backend (Agent SDK compile + report scripts, pipeline orchestrator, cron) and claude.ai-style web app (Next.js dashboard + chat with Agent SDK streaming, wiki viewer, auth, dark mode).

userStories.title: Create Agent SDK compile script
userStories.description: As a system operator, I want wiki compilation to run via the Agent SDK so that it can be triggered by cron without Claude Code.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/compile.py exists and runs with: python scripts/compile.py
Uses claude_agent_sdk.query() with allowed_tools=['Read', 'Write', 'Edit', 'Glob', 'Grep']
Sets setting_sources=['project'] so CLAUDE.md is loaded automatically
Reads wiki/log.md to identify uncompiled raw files in raw/github-daily/
Creates or updates wiki articles in wiki/contributors/, wiki/projects/, wiki/patterns/, wiki/connections/
Updates wiki/index.md with new or modified entries
Appends to wiki/log.md with timestamp and summary of what was compiled
Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable (exits with error if missing)
Loads .env via python-dotenv
Prints cost estimate and summary after completion
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference: .claude/commands/compile-wiki.md for the prompt logic. The script wraps the same prompt in an Agent SDK call.

userStories.title: Create Agent SDK report generation script
userStories.description: As a system operator, I want report generation to run via the Agent SDK so that morning briefings and EOD summaries are generated automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/generate_report.py exists with --type morning|eod|dashboard and --date YYYY-MM-DD flags
Uses claude_agent_sdk.query() with allowed_tools=['Read', 'Glob', 'Grep', 'Write']
Sets setting_sources=['project'] so CLAUDE.md and .claude/commands/ are loaded
For --type morning: reads raw/github-daily/YYYY-MM-DD-am.md + wiki articles, writes to wiki/reports/YYYY-MM-DD-morning-briefing.md
For --type eod: reads AM + PM snapshots + morning briefing + wiki, writes to wiki/reports/YYYY-MM-DD-eod-summary.md
For --type dashboard: reads 7 days of data + wiki, writes to wiki/reports/YYYY-MM-DD-team-dashboard.md
Defaults to today's date if --date not provided
Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable
Loads .env via python-dotenv
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference: .claude/commands/morning-briefing.md, eod-summary.md, team-dashboard.md for prompt logic.

userStories.title: Create pipeline orchestrator script
userStories.description: As a system operator, I want a single command that runs extract, compile, report, and git push so cron only needs one entry.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/run_pipeline.py exists with --period am|pm flag
Runs team_pulse.py --period {period} and verifies the output file was created in raw/github-daily/
Runs compile.py and verifies wiki/log.md was updated
Runs generate_report.py --type morning (for AM) or --type eod (for PM)
Runs git add, git commit, git push after all steps complete successfully
Logs each step's status and timing to scripts/pipeline.log
Exits with non-zero code if ANY step fails — does NOT commit partial state
Prints summary: files created, articles updated, total time
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001 and US-002. This is the single entry point for cron.

userStories.title: Create .env template and crontab configuration
userStories.description: As a system operator, I want documented configuration files so I can set up the system on any machine.
acceptanceCriteria: .env.example exists with: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your-key-here, GITHUB_TOKEN= (optional), TEAM_PULSE_REPOS=karpathy/autoresearch,garrytan/gstack, TEAM_PULSE_TIMEZONE=Asia/Bangkok
scripts/team_pulse.py reads TEAM_PULSE_REPOS from env if set (falls back to DEFAULT_REPOS constant)
All Agent SDK scripts (compile.py, generate_report.py) load .env via python-dotenv at startup
scripts/crontab.txt contains two entries: 0 0 * * * for 7AM Bangkok (AM) and 0 11 * * * for 6PM Bangkok (PM)
Each cron entry runs run_pipeline.py with correct --period flag
scripts/setup-cron.sh installs the crontab (with instructions as comments)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Initialize Next.js web app with Tailwind and shadcn/ui
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the web app scaffolded with the correct tech stack so I can build components.
acceptanceCriteria: web/ directory created with Next.js 14+ using App Router
Tailwind CSS configured and working
shadcn/ui initialized with default components (Button, Card, Input, Badge, Sheet)
Inter font loaded for body text
JetBrains Mono loaded for code blocks
web/package.json has all required dependencies
npm run dev starts dev server on localhost:3000 without errors
Root page at / renders Team Pulse placeholder text
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See docs/frontend-design.md for full design spec. Use App Router, not Pages Router.

userStories.title: Build three-panel layout with sidebar
userStories.description: As a team lead, I want a claude.ai-style layout with a sidebar for navigation and a main content area.
acceptanceCriteria: Layout has: sidebar (280px) + header bar (56px) + main content area
Sidebar has three collapsible sections: Quick Actions, Reports Archive, Wiki Browser
Quick Actions section has buttons: New Chat, Morning Briefing, EOD Summary, Team Dashboard
Reports Archive lists available dates from wiki/reports/ directory
Wiki Browser has subsections: Contributors, Projects, Patterns, Connections reading from wiki/ directory
Clicking a sidebar item sets the main area content (route change)
Active sidebar item is visually highlighted
Sidebar background: #f9fafb (light mode)
Header shows: Team Pulse logo/text + current date + placeholder for user menu
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: See docs/frontend-design.md section 1 (Sidebar) and section 2 (Header). Use shadcn/ui Sheet for mobile sidebar.

userStories.title: Build markdown report viewer
userStories.description: As a team lead, I want to read morning briefings and EOD summaries as rendered markdown in the browser.
acceptanceCriteria: API route GET /api/reports/[date]/[type] reads and returns markdown from wiki/reports/
Page route /reports/[date]/[type] renders the markdown with react-markdown + remark-gfm
Tables render with proper styling (borders, alternating rows)
Headers, bold, code blocks, and lists render correctly
Back to Chat button navigates to /
404 page shown if report does not exist for that date
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: navigate to /reports/2026-04-11/morning-briefing, confirm tables render
userStories.notes: Use react-markdown with remark-gfm plugin. The wiki/reports/ files are standard markdown.

userStories.title: Build wiki article viewer with wikilink support
userStories.description: As a team lead, I want to browse contributor profiles and pattern articles with clickable cross-references.
acceptanceCriteria: API route GET /api/wiki/[...slug] reads markdown from wiki/ directory
Page route /wiki/[...slug] renders the article (e.g., /wiki/contributors/garrytan)
YAML frontmatter parsed and displayed as metadata header (title, updated date, tags)
[[wikilinks]] in article text render as clickable chips/links navigating within the app
Related section links are clickable and navigate correctly
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: navigate to /wiki/contributors/garrytan, confirm wikilinks work
userStories.notes: Parse [[contributors/garrytan]] into links to /wiki/contributors/garrytan. Use regex to find wikilinks in markdown.

userStories.title: Build chat interface with message display
userStories.description: As a team member, I want a chat interface at the root route where I can type questions and see responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Chat is the default view at /
Input bar at bottom: auto-expanding textarea + Send button
User messages display with 'You' label and light gray background (#f3f4f6)
AI messages display with 'Team Pulse' label and white background
Messages render markdown (tables, headers, bold, code blocks)
Send button disabled while response is loading (spinner shown)
Chat area scrolls to bottom on new messages
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: type a message, confirm it appears in the chat area
userStories.notes: This story builds the UI only. The Agent SDK backend (streaming) is US-010.

userStories.title: Connect chat to Agent SDK backend with streaming
userStories.description: As a team member, I want my questions answered by Claude reading the wiki, with responses streaming in real-time.
acceptanceCriteria: API route POST /api/ask accepts { question: string, sessionId?: string }
Backend uses claude_agent_sdk.query() with allowed_tools=['Read', 'Glob', 'Grep'] and setting_sources=['project']
Response streams via Server-Sent Events to the frontend
Text appears word-by-word in the chat UI as the Agent SDK yields messages
Session ID captured from Agent SDK init message and stored in browser sessionStorage
Follow-up questions use resume=sessionId for conversation memory
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY loaded from environment
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: ask 'Who is busiest today?', confirm streaming response with wiki content
userStories.notes: Depends on US-009 (chat UI). The Agent SDK runs in the Next.js API route. Stream using ReadableStream or EventSource.

userStories.title: Display source citations in chat responses
userStories.description: As a team lead, I want to see which wiki articles were consulted so I can verify the answer.
acceptanceCriteria: Source citation block displayed at bottom of each AI response
Each source rendered as a clickable chip: [garrytan.md] [burnout-signals.md]
Clicking a source chip navigates to the wiki article viewer (/wiki/...)
[[wikilinks]] within response text also render as clickable chips
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: ask a question, confirm source chips appear and navigate correctly
userStories.notes: Parse Agent SDK tool_use messages to identify which files were Read. Display as citations.

userStories.title: Add suggested questions on empty chat
userStories.description: As a new user, I want to see suggested questions when the chat is empty so I know what to ask.
acceptanceCriteria: Empty chat displays 4 suggestion cards in a 2x2 grid centered in main area
Cards: 'Who needs help?' (burnout), 'Today's briefing' (morning report), 'Weekly summary' (management), 'Compare repos' (gstack vs autoresearch)
Each card has an icon, title, and short description
Clicking a card sends that question to the chat
Cards disappear once the first message is sent
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: load /, confirm 4 cards visible, click one, confirm chat starts

userStories.title: Add dark/light mode toggle
userStories.description: As a user, I want to switch between dark and light themes.
acceptanceCriteria: Toggle button in header bar with sun/moon icon
Light mode colors per docs/frontend-design.md: white bg, #111827 text, #4f46e5 accent
Dark mode colors per docs/frontend-design.md: #0f172a bg, #f1f5f9 text, #818cf8 accent
Theme preference saved in localStorage and restored on page load
All components respect the theme: sidebar, chat, report viewer, wiki viewer
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: toggle dark mode, confirm all areas switch correctly
userStories.notes: Use next-themes or Tailwind dark: class strategy. See docs/frontend-design.md section 4.

userStories.title: Add GitHub OAuth authentication
userStories.description: As an admin, I want only authenticated team members to access the app.
acceptanceCriteria: NextAuth.js configured with GitHub OAuth provider
Unauthenticated users see a login page with 'Sign in with GitHub' button
Authenticated users see their avatar and name in the header bar
Clicking the avatar shows a dropdown with 'Sign out' option
GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET added to .env.example
NEXTAUTH_SECRET added to .env.example
All API routes return 401 for unauthenticated requests
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: access / while logged out, confirm redirect to login page
userStories.notes: Use NextAuth.js v4+ with the GitHub provider. Session stored in JWT.

userStories.title: Make layout mobile responsive
userStories.description: As a team lead, I want to use the app on my phone.
acceptanceCriteria: At <768px: sidebar hidden, hamburger menu icon in header toggles sidebar as overlay
At 768-1024px: sidebar collapsed to 60px icon-only mode
At >1024px: full 280px sidebar shown
Chat input bar fixed at bottom on all screen sizes
Tables in reports scroll horizontally on small screens (overflow-x-auto)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser: resize to 375px width, confirm sidebar hidden and chat usable
userStories.notes: Use Tailwind responsive breakpoints (md:, lg:). shadcn/ui Sheet component for mobile sidebar overlay.

userStories.title: Add rate limiting and usage tracking
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to limit API costs and track usage.
acceptanceCriteria: Rate limit: max 100 POST /api/ask requests per user per day
Rate limit exceeded returns 429 with message: 'Daily query limit reached. Resets at midnight Bangkok time.'
Usage counter displayed in header or settings: 'X/100 queries today'
Rate limit tracked per GitHub user (from auth session)
Rate limit resets at 00:00 Bangkok time daily
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Simple in-memory counter per user is fine for v1. Persistent storage (Redis/DB) for production later.
